verdict.rationale: cubic offers an Analytics API providing PR-level data on flagged/fixed issues and AI-authored code volume, which supports engineering-lead visibility into findings and fix rates, but there's no evidence of a built-in dashboard UI, org-wide acceptance-rate visualization, or review coverage metrics across teams/repos. missing for 10: a first-party dashboard/UI screenshot or doc showing org-level rollups, explicit 'acceptance rate' metric, and review coverage tracking across repos/teams.
